protocol.design: Balanced full-rank parameter boxes with dense shared capacity constraints; independent all-active-subset global references on the small problems. All parameter directions have the same singular value. For fixed q and seed, G uses leading columns of the same full orthogonal matrix. Fixed-q=32 comparisons therefore increase latent dimension without changing the target or existing latent columns. A separate rotated folded-ball family has exact global risks and affine zero-penalty controls. Every timing repetition starts a fresh query pipeline, including forward setup, all forward queries, sampled-anchor solves, upper-risk calculation, separation SOCPs and bookkeeping. All planned outcomes, including non-detections and failures, are retained.

warnings: Solution may be inaccurate. Try another solver, adjusting the solver settings, or solve with verbose=True for more information.
scope: Balanced full-rank boxes with coupled constraints, independent complete-region small references, and rotated full-dimensional ball controls. No global small reference is supplied to the query pipeline. Costs include query setup, queries, all sampled-anchor solves, upper bounds, SOCP checks and bookkeeping. Primal/dual residuals and numerical backoffs are diagnostics, not interval certification.
